answer: Give each agent a plume: a hash-chained trail of completed, independently verified tasks that cannot be rewritten after the fact. A new identity starts as a closed lotus bud, capped at tiny transaction values, and the bud opens petal by petal only as the plume grows with real, paid work. A wander audit then picks a random past task from the plume and re-runs it: a clone that faked its trail fails the replay and forfeits its stake, while an honest agent passes cheaply because the work is already done.
